verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA H200 SXM is a physical data-center GPU. A sandbox or test environment kept separate from production data is a property of a service or API, so the question is a category error for this kind of hardware. Nothing in the pack shows the GPU itself shipping such a sandbox. MIG partitioning and Confidential Computing are hardware isolation features, not a test environment. Brev Launchables and the build.nvidia.com free endpoints are separate NVIDIA services, not capabilities of the H200.
